obsolete_loose - obsolete_strict = 0: all 9 superseded pages use the exact 'Obsolete. Superseded by ...' form, so no 'Obsolete for documents created in ...' variant appears in this family.

MaterialID is superseded but never uses the word 'Obsolete' - its header line 12 reads 'Not supported in SOLIDWORKS 2011 and later. Superseded by [[IRenderMaterial::GetMaterialIds]].' => it is invisible to BOTH criteria A and B, so both counts under-report real supersession by 1.

E and F do not overlap and together do not exhaust the family: 16 of 103 signatures have parenthesised non-empty parameter lists (e.g. AddEntity, SetCenterPoint2, IGetEntities), which are neither zero-arg methods nor properties.

The overview's 82/21 split does not reconcile with either the front matter or the signature shapes.
